name: US House Polarization (DW-NOMINATE)
short_description: Distance between Democratic and Republican House means on the first DW-NOMINATE dimension, 46th–118th Congress
source: Voteview / Lewis, Poole, Rosenthal et al.
association_note: Huntington's creedal-passion cycle predicts ~60-year polarization peaks. DW-NOMINATE is the cleanest long-run roll-call proxy available.

name: US TFP growth (5-yr rolling)
short_description: 5-year centered rolling average of Fernald's utilization-adjusted US TFP growth (annual `dtfp`), derived by this project; coverage 1948–2025
association_note: Kondratiev waves predict 50–60 year cycles of technological paradigm expansion and exhaustion. TFP growth is the most direct measurable output.

name: US Top 1% Wealth Share
short_description: Share of total household wealth held by the top 1% of US adults; sparse decadal points 1820–1910, then annual 1913–2024
source: WID · World Inequality Database (retrieved via Our World in Data)
association_note: Direct proxy for Turchin's elite-overproduction driver — when wealth concentrates, elite competition intensifies and instability follows.

name: US Share of World GDP
short_description: US GDP as share of all-countries GDP in the Maddison Project Database, 1870–2022
association_note: Imperial-arc proxy. Peak at 1945 (~42%) is exactly Dalio's reference peak year — the cycle and the data are visibly aligned by construction.

name: US Liberal Democracy Index (V-Dem)
short_description: V-Dem liberal-democracy index for the US, 1789–2025, scale 0–1
source: V-Dem Institute v15 (retrieved via Our World in Data)
association_note: Generational-cycle theory predicts crisis lows that line up with stress on liberal-democratic institutions. V-Dem's recent US drop is the clearest empirical analogue to Strauss-Howe's 'Fourth Turning'.

name: Global conflict deaths (log) per 100k
short_description: Natural log of (1 + deaths per 100,000) — log-transformed to keep WWI/WWII from flattening the rest of the series
source: Our World in Data · Project Mars (Lyall 2020)
association_note: Rough proxy for Khaldun-style state-breakdown intensity. Log-transformed because WWI/WWII spikes otherwise dominate; the transform reveals secular trend and lets the cycle pairing breathe.
